# ChessStream Africa

Live chess broadcasting platform for African tournaments and federations.

## About
ChessStream Africa provides real-time chess broadcasting for African chess events. We pull live game data from Lichess broadcasts and present it in an easy-to-use web interface.

## Features
- Live broadcast viewing with real-time move updates
- Game analysis with PGN import
- Daily chess puzzles
- Player directory with FIDE profiles
- Courses from Prochess Academy

## Data Sources
- Lichess Broadcast API for live games
- FIDE for player ratings and profiles
